name: apx-standard
description: APX — APDS Parking eXtensions: an open companion standard to APDS 4.1 adding data push/pull profiles, control, alerts, discovery, accounts/payments, LPR, reservations, permits, tolling, violations/enforcement, validation programs, credential lifecycle, and valet.

scripts.spec:bundle: redocly bundle spec/openapi/apx.yaml --config tools/redocly.yaml -o spec/dist/apx-v1.yaml && redocly bundle spec/openapi/apx.yaml --config tools/redocly.yaml -o spec/dist/apx-v1.json && node tools/apply-overlay.mjs && node tools/build-edition.mjs
scripts.docs:build: redocly build-docs spec/dist/apx-v1.yaml -o site/reference.html && redocly build-docs spec/dist/apx-parcs.json -o site/parcs.html && node tools/build-standard.mjs && node tools/build-site.mjs && npm run apxdocs:html
scripts.test: npm run vendor:check && npm run registries:check && npm run spec:lint && npm run spec:bundle && npm run spec:profile && npm run spec:style && npm run spec:smoke && npm run examples:check && npm run scenarios:check && npm run submission:check && npm run apxdocs:check
